div.div: مِسْيَاعٌ A she-camel that goes away in the place of pasturing: (K:) mentioned by J in art. سوع, q. v.: (TA:) or that bears, or suffers, neglect, or being left alone, (اَلَّتِى تَحْمِلُ الضَّيْعَةَ, [for the last of which words we find in some copies of the K الضَّيْعَةَ, but it is said in the TA that the former is the right reading, as is shown by its being added,]) and bad superintendence or management; (K, TA;) thus expl. by As: (TA:) or upon which one journeys and returns; (K;) thus expl. by Sgh, but this is the explanation of مِرْبَاعٌ, with which it is coupled. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
